last_findings.claim: The r215 Call to Chaos chain test still depends on a pool roll at a literal seed, and the comment this branch added says the opposite: that the seed is arbitrary.
last_findings.evidence: `chaos_cursor` only finds the first cursor whose effect roll is "recast". The recast then picks the edition with `pick_generated` from the `tags: [Call to Chaos]` pool of every set (`crates/engine/src/subsystems/call_to_chaos.rs:247-249`; core-095, classicplus-073, meditative-095). The test asserts `plays.len() == 2` and `played == 2` and counts only `CardPlayed` events whose `def_id == CHAOS` (core-095), so it passes only while that pick lands on core-095. `c095_call_to_chaos.rs:278-281` says so itself: "pinning the roll alone does not pin the edition". Its `recast_of_core_cursor` searches the edition too; this helper does not.
